	padding: 20px 40px 40px 40px;
}

.wp-show-posts-columns .wp-show-posts-inner {
    flex: 0.9;
}

.posted-on .updated + .entry-date {
    display: none;
}

ul, ol {
margin-top: 0px !important;
}

.comments-area {
    margin-top: 1.5em;
    padding-left: 20px;
    padding-right: 10px;
}

.display-posts-listing.grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-gap: 16px;
	margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.display-posts-listing.grid .title {
	display: block;
}

.display-posts-listing.grid img { 
	display: block; 
	max-width: 100%; 
	height: auto; 
}
@media (min-width: 769px) {
	.display-posts-listing.grid {		
		grid-template-columns: repeat( 2, 1fr ); 
	}
}

@media (min-width: 1075px) {
	.display-posts-listing.grid {
		grid-template-columns: repeat( 3, 1fr );
	}
}

.posted-on .published {
    display: none;
}

.page-header-image, .page-header-image-single {
    line-height: 0;
    display: none;
}

.inside-article .grid-container {
	padding-bottom:20px;
}

.page-header {
    margin-bottom: 30px;
    display: none;
}

.wp-show-posts a {

}

@media (max-width: 1225px) {

    padding-top: 20px;

}

wp-image-16367 lazyloaded" data-lazy-src="https://s18856.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/DSC08978-600px.jpg" data-pin-description="Jeremy from Living the Dream" data-was-processed="true" src="https://s18856.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/DSC08978-600px.jpg" style="padding-right:10px; padding-bottom:10px; padding-top:10px;" title="Jeremy from Living the Dream" width="350"/></noscript><strong>Welcome to Living the Dream!</strong> I'm Jeremy, a full-time blogger based in Pittsburgh. I've been sharing travel, lifestyle design, and blogging tips on this site for over a decade, and in that time I've visited 70+ countries all over the world.</p><p>Throw in stories from guest authors, staff writers, and my favorite travel partner Angie (my wife), and we've featured stories from every continent!</p><hr/><h2><strong>What You'll Find on Living the Dream</strong></h2><div class="code-block code-block-67" style="margin: 8px 0; clear: both;"><div><div class="grid-container" style="padding-bottom:20px">
<div class="grid-25 tablet-grid-25 mobile-grid-50 first-column"><img alt="Living the Dream on Easter Island" data-pin-description="Living the Dream on Easter Island" src="https://www.livingthedreamrtw.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/10286795_10100436013677110_3415031752498673217_o-768x514-600px.jpg" title="Living the Dream on Easter Island"/>
</div>
<div class="grid-25 tablet-grid-25 mobile-grid-50 second-column"><img alt="The Seychelles" data-pin-description="The Seychelles" src="https://www.livingthedreamrtw.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/DSC04352-600px-600x338-600px.jpg" title="The Seychelles"/>
</div>
<div class="grid-25 tablet-grid-25 mobile-grid-50 third-column"><img alt="Jeremy and Angie at Everest Base Camp" data-pin-description="Jeremy and Angie at Everest Base Camp" src="https://www.livingthedreamrtw.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/Everest-Base-Camp-600x450-600x450-600px.jpg" title="Jeremy and Angie at Everest Base Camp"/>
</div>
<div class="grid-25 tablet-grid-25 mobile-grid-50 fourth-column"><img alt="Petra Jordan" data-pin-description="Petra Jordan" src="https://www.livingthedreamrtw.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/Petra-Jordan_6590813641_l-768x514-600px.jpg" title="Petra Jordan"/>
</div>
</div></div></div><p>At its core, Living the Dream is a travel blog- one that focuses on tips and advice, adventure activities, and food and beverage from around the world. While we love to visit unusual destinations, we're also not shy about visiting conventional spots too!</p><p>In the past 10 years I've <a data-wpel-link="internal" href="https://www.livingthedreamrtw.com/the-faq-about-everest-base-camp" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_self">hiked to Everest Base Camp</a>, marveled at the moai of <a data-wpel-link="internal" href="https://www.livingthedreamrtw.com/how-to-visit-easter-island-without" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_self">Easter Island</a>, splurged out on points in <a data-wpel-link="internal" href="https://www.livingthedreamrtw.com/visit-seychelles" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_self">the Seychelles</a>, visited the <a data-wpel-link="internal" href="https://www.livingthedreamrtw.com/gorilla-trekking-in-uganda" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_self">mountain gorillas of Uganda</a>, gone <a data-wpel-link="internal" href="https://www.livingthedreamrtw.com/should-you-take-yacht-tour-in-galapagos" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_self">scuba diving in the Galapagos</a>, and even scored <a data-wpel-link="internal" href="https://www.livingthedreamrtw.com/reservations-for-french-laundry" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_self">French Laundry reservations</a>. These are just a few of the numerous activities featured on this site, with more being added every single month!</p><p>Since then, the site has expanded to provide lifestyle design and blogging tips. The goal? To help others who are looking to achieve <a data-wpel-link="internal" href="https://www.livingthedreamrtw.com/debt-avalanche" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_self">financial independence</a> via blogging just like I did in 2018. All-in-all, Living the Dream features everything I do to live my dreams, plus providing all the tips you need in order to live yours! So I have to ask, <strong>where will your dreams take you?</strong></p><h3><center><strong>Scroll down to get started!</strong></center></h3><hr/><div class="grid-container" style="padding-bottom:0px;"><div class="grid-50 tablet-grid-0 mobile-grid-0 first-column"><div class="code-block code-block-69 ai-viewport-1" style="margin: 8px 0;
